summary: CIMG Inc., a Nevada-incorporated Hong Kong-based miscellaneous retailer, filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026, disclosing a September 24, 2026 securities purchase agreement with certain non-U.S. investors for a $8.7 million private placement of 3,000,000,000 common shares at $0.0029 per share, payable in U.S. dollars or Bitcoin. Conducted offshore under Regulation S, unregistered shares, closing expected within five business days. This is a routine exempt capital-raising takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution, Bitcoin funding mechanics, and closing-condition risk.
